blocks.text: Ceramics are hard but brittle materials that have high melting temperatures and very good insulating ability, which suits them to high-temperature and electrical uses. Chemically they contain a blend of silicates and oxides of alkali and alkaline earth metals and of aluminium, such as K2O, Na2O, CaO and Al2SiO5. Their strong bonds and fixed structures give them strength, durability, and resistance to corrosion and heat. They are used in pottery, furnaces, tiles and sanitary ware (porcelain), windows and optical fibres (glass), and spark plugs (alumina).
